issues.description: The memory-region implementations use &self receivers for Inv and InvView methods whose traits require self by value, so the proof-retaining trait implementations do not match their declared interfaces.
issues.rationale: vstd_extra/src/ownership.rs declares Inv::inv(self), InvView::view(self), and view_preserves_inv(self). MemoryRegion implements all three with &self and MemRegionModel implements inv(&self). The next direct-child commit changes precisely these four receivers to self. memory_region is actively declared by ostd/src/boot/mod.rs and memory_region_specs by specs/ostd/src/lib.rs. This is a trait-signature mismatch in retained specification/proof code, not a claim of ordinary ghost-erased runtime failure.
